visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Medium: Real-life video. A woman wearing a red and white striped costume with a tall cone hat stands in a studio. She has long black hair and smiles broadly while gesturing with her hands. Behind her is a whiteboard and a television screen displaying a woman's portrait. The room is brightly lit with overhead studio lights. (2) A person in a full-body red bodysuit with a yellow LEGO-themed mask performs a squat move before standing and walking toward the camera. They carry a grey fabric object. The studio floor is light grey and reflective. (3) A man wearing a Popeye costume, including a blue and black shirt, blue pants, and a white sailor hat, poses with his arms outstretched and a joyful facial expression. He wears thick-rimmed glasses. (4) A woman dressed in a Goku costume from Dragon Ball Z walks across the studio space. She has spiked black hair and wears an orange gi with blue accents. She smiles and poses for a camera off-screen. (5) A person in a Bart Simpson-inspired costume, featuring a yellow long-sleeved shirt and red shorts, peeps from behind a black curtain. They jump out and dance energetically, showing high physical activity. (6) A man in an Ash Ketchum costume from Pokemon stands centrally, holding a red and white Pokeball toward the lens. He wears a blue and white vest and a red baseball cap. (7) A woman in a dark blue police romper holds a prop gun and a walkie-talkie. She laughs while looking at someone off-camera. She has short black hair and visible knee pads. (8) A man wearing an orange traffic cone costume stands rigidly, grinning. The background remains the studio with technical equipment visible. (9) A man in a Marge Simpson costume, with a green dress and a tall blue wig, poses with a yellow handbag. (10) A large group of people in all the previously mentioned costumes gathers together. Two men in pink Barbie-themed outfits dance at the front. The group is positioned in front of a red curtain and a Christmas tree. (11) The entire group poses for a final wide shot. A man in the center is shirtless with a large pink flower prop. The lighting is warm and festive.
